premises: Phase-selective recrystallization (PSR) can be applied to a eutectic high-entropy alloy with a hierarchical lamellar microstructure.
PSR selectively recrystallizes the ductile phase without coarsening or dissolving the lamellar colony architecture.
Recrystallization of the ductile phase reduces dislocation pile-ups at semi-coherent phase boundaries.
Reducing dislocation pile-ups lowers local stress concentrations, delaying microcrack initiation.
This intervention improves room-temperature tensile ductility while retaining or increasing strength.
